reviews.title: Not for seniors
reviews.text: They ask you all the questions at the very beginning about any problem you have and your age.  I informed him I have back problems, specifically sciatica.  I also told them that I am 79 years old only a couple of months away from 80, there is no way on this earth that a normal 79 year-old can keep this kind of pace up.  The exercises are not the kind of tai chi that is meant for seniors.  It is not slow controlled movements. The pace is way too fast. The last one I did got to my sciatica.  I had suffered from sciatica for three years. The last year, having to walk with a cane I do not want to do that again and I know this plan will make that happen.  They also said they were offering a free Coach.,  I made the appointment gave all the information filled out all the information forms that the Coach wanted to have ahead of time,  the Coach never called. I waited for two hours.

reviews.title: Thanks to Emma
reviews.text:
I've only been using Lasta for a short time, but I'm already really impressed, and a huge part of that comes down to Emma. From my very first interaction with her, she made the whole experience feel welcoming and easy rather than overwhelming, which is exactly what I needed when starting something new.
Emma has been incredibly helpful and supportive as I've gotten going. She took the time to understand where I was starting from and what I was hoping to get out of this, and it shows in how she's approached working with me. I never felt like just another name on a list — it's felt genuinely personal.
One thing that's really stood out is how responsive she is. Whenever I've sent an email with a question or just wanted to check in, I've gotten a thoughtful reply back quickly. That kind of consistent communication makes a big difference and has helped me stay motivated and on track.
As for the actual program, the exercises for me so far have been a great fit. They feel well-suited to my needs and current level, not generic or one-size-fits-all, which makes me feel like there's real thought going into my plan.
Overall, I'm really happy with my experience so far and excited to keep going. If you're on the fence about trying Lasta, having someone like Emma in your corner makes all the difference. Highly recommend!

Micko aka Michele

reviews.title: Horrible billing
reviews.text:
Updated: after my review the company did give me a 50% refund.

My experience with Lasta has been extremely frustrating. The billing practices feel anything but transparent, and I was charged for services I did not receive. Trying to get the issue resolved has been even worse—the customer service has been unhelpful, difficult to deal with, and seemingly more interested in defending the charge than actually addressing the problem.

A company should not charge customers for services that were never provided and then make customers fight to get their money back.That is unacceptable.

What makes this particularly disappointing is the complete lack of accountability. When you’re dealing with someone’s money, billing should be clear, accurate, and easy to resolve when something goes wrong. Instead, my experience left me feeling that Lasta’s billing practices are deliberately difficult to navigate.

I would be strongly caution anyone against signing up until they have thoroughly reviewed the billing terms and understand exactly what they are agreeing to. Based on my experience, I would not recommend Lasta and will not use this company again.

Lasta has lost my trust, not because of one billing mistake, but because of how poorly the company handled it afterward.
